# Watch the tutorial   [Skip link to Watch the tutorial](https://docs.leena.ai/docs/guardrails\#watch-the-tutorial)

Guardrails.mp4 - Google Drive

Guardrails are organisation-wide safety rules that validate every AI Colleague conversation — both what employees send and what the AI Colleague responds with — before execution continues. They are configured once and apply across all AI Colleagues automatically.

![](https://files.readme.io/73efe6637a987d44adf6ef9951a42f319933b9c9c5eb56cc483b598732be9bdc-image.png)

# Where to find it   [Skip link to Where to find it](https://docs.leena.ai/docs/guardrails\#where-to-find-it)

Open the **Admin Console**, then go to **Orchestrator → Guardrails**.

# What's covered   [Skip link to What's covered](https://docs.leena.ai/docs/guardrails\#whats-covered)

Three guardrails ship out of the box:

| Guardrail | What it protects against | Applies to |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **PII Detection** | Personally identifiable information in conversations | Employee input and AI output |
| **Moderation** | Harmful, hateful, or explicit content | Employee input and AI output |
| **Jailbreak** | Prompt injection and attempts to override the assistant's safety rules | Employee input only |

# Turning guardrails on   [Skip link to Turning guardrails on](https://docs.leena.ai/docs/guardrails\#turning-guardrails-on)

If guardrails have never been enabled, the page shows **Guardrails are disabled** with a single **Enable guardrails** button. Enabling is an organisation-wide action — it activates all three guardrails together.

![](https://files.readme.io/43965b1b7be77bb6ee49262cfb02169c984dfbd4c8fd45f1a8cc4fbbb95700ed-Screenshot_2026-04-02_at_12.53.55PM.png)

Once enabled, each guardrail appears as a card showing its name, status (Active or Inactive), a description, and — where applicable — who last updated it and when.

![](https://files.readme.io/79f8e9d22fefbb53c36f67954b472ae80fce297ded89983866215fb6f0f1873e-Screenshot_2026-04-02_at_12.54.38PM.png)

Disabling all guardrails also asks for confirmation, warning that validation stops applying to AI Colleague executions until they're switched back on.

> 📘
>
> ### What each card lets you do   [Skip link to What each card lets you do](https://docs.leena.ai/docs/guardrails\#what-each-card-lets-you-do)
>
> A guardrail's kebab menu offers only the actions that guardrail permits — some can be edited, some can be individually activated or deactivated, and some can only be viewed. In practice **PII Detection** is the one you configure and toggle independently; Moderation and Jailbreak are read-only views managed through the organisation-wide toggle.
>
> Where a card offers nothing at all, no menu appears.

Activating an individual guardrail applies immediately. **Deactivating asks for confirmation first**, since it stops those rules applying until you re-enable them. Every change is written to the audit trail.

# PII Detection   [Skip link to PII Detection](https://docs.leena.ai/docs/guardrails\#pii-detection)

Click the **PII Detection** card to open its detail view, showing the current action and the selected entities as chips. Click **Edit** to change them.

![](https://files.readme.io/58ee46177ff308c5246b15e08680e09b31adfbc8533dec089fc9c5b7b28827d2-Screenshot_2026-04-02_at_12.57.52PM.png)

## Action on detection   [Skip link to Action on detection](https://docs.leena.ai/docs/guardrails\#action-on-detection)

Choose what happens when PII is found:

| Action | What happens |
| --- | --- |
| **Mask & continue** | The detected value is replaced with a redaction placeholder and the conversation continues. The default, and the right choice where the masked version is still useful |
| **Block request** | Execution halts, an error is returned to the employee, and the violation is logged. Use for severe cases where continuing would breach policy |
| **Log & continue** | The conversation proceeds unmodified and the violation is recorded. Use for monitoring, where blocking would hurt the employee experience |

## PII entities   [Skip link to PII entities](https://docs.leena.ai/docs/guardrails\#pii-entities)

![](https://files.readme.io/70aa511c9b5920b79aec74d3bd25352529c1ab6d0cb3e4bb023b2372fe47475d-Screenshot_2026-04-02_at_1.00.22PM.png)

In edit mode, tick the data types you want detected. Entities are grouped — common identifiers such as credit card and IBAN numbers, alongside region-specific groups covering the USA, UK, Europe, and Asia-Pacific with their national identifiers, tax numbers, and health identifiers.

Enable only what's relevant to where you operate. Every additional entity is another chance for a false positive to mask or block something an employee legitimately needed to send.

Click **Save** to apply, or **Cancel** to exit without saving. Leaving with unsaved edits prompts you to save or discard.

# Moderation   [Skip link to Moderation](https://docs.leena.ai/docs/guardrails\#moderation)

Click the Moderation card to see which content categories are active. They cover sexual content, hate and harassment, violence, self-harm, and illegal activities, each with more specific sub-categories.

![](https://files.readme.io/0e56b869a717234494897b6293bf003dff9386b68052d85fee41e5aa448b5108-Screenshot_2026-04-02_at_1.03.01PM.png)

> ⚠️
>
> ### Moderation always blocks   [Skip link to Moderation always blocks](https://docs.leena.ai/docs/guardrails\#moderation-always-blocks)
>
> There is no action choice here. When a moderation category is triggered the request is blocked — masking and logging are not options.

# Jailbreak   [Skip link to Jailbreak](https://docs.leena.ai/docs/guardrails\#jailbreak)

The Jailbreak guardrail blocks attempts to manipulate the AI Colleague into bypassing its safety rules: prompt injection, role hijacking, and system prompt overrides.

Its detail view is read-only. Alongside the description it shows the **confidence threshold** range the detector operates within — useful context when reviewing why something was or wasn't caught. Detection runs automatically with all patterns on, and every blocked attempt is logged.

# Reviewing violations   [Skip link to Reviewing violations](https://docs.leena.ai/docs/guardrails\#reviewing-violations)

Guardrail violations appear in Run History as their own step, so you can see exactly which guardrail fired, on which turn, and what happened next. See [Guardrails Violation in Run History](https://docs.leena.ai/docs/run-execution#guardrail-violation-step).
